name: sharepoint-workbench-setup
description: Foundational access, connection and project/document configuration for the whole workbench: guides app-registration requests (unattended App-Only/certificate and interactive/delegated), generates the root SharePoint connection config, runs the document-workflow intake wizard, validates the SharePoint connection and written configuration/profile files, resolves document input/output paths, and provides live network-reachability, authentication and PnP effective-capability probes. Zero tenant I/O by default and zero document extraction/rendering -- live probes are opt-in scripts you run yourself.
